Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes, it can be handled differently depending on what was damaged.

• If it’s a live plant: We do not process standard returns on live plants. If a plant arrives with a concern, our team reviews it instead. Photos are usually needed so they can assess the plant’s condition and advise on next steps.

• If it’s a non-plant item: A normal return may be possible if it is within the return window and meets the item’s return conditions. If the item arrived damaged, our team would still want details and photos so they can review that specific issue.

So the main difference is this: a standard return follows the return policy, while a damaged item is reviewed based on the item type and the condition it arrived in.

If you want, send me the item name and whether it’s a plant or a garden supply, and I’ll tell you exactly how it would be handled.
